title: PES 0110 writes a rectangle as an editable CEmbLine object
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes PE-DESIGN 11's #PES0110 layout: the thread table, one CEmbLine per shape with its line and region attributes and outline, the sewing-order list, then the PEC section. The design is the owner's baseline r01's rectangle (tests/fixtures/pe11/PROVENANCE.md): 10 x 10 mm at (10,10) mm, line Zigzag 2.0 mm / 4.5 line/mm in Red with under sewing, region Fill 4.5 line/mm in Silver, at OpenStitch's default fill direction (0 degrees; PE-DESIGN's tool default is 45). Reference: PE-DESIGN 11.50 opened the file with no warning and the rectangle editable, showed the direction 0 degrees the file holds, and re-saved it with the object section unchanged except its own pattern block.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 object list: every field is mapped from the owner's PE-DESIGN 11.50 files (crates/openstitch-formats/tests/fixtures/pe11); the writer's rewrite of those files is byte-identical outside the documented differences (pes11.rs, written_object_sections_match_pe_designs_bytes_outside_the_documented_differences)
PE-DESIGN 11.50 re-save of a.pes (MANIFEST pes-0110-editable-shapes, 2026-10-29): opens with no warning, the rectangle editable; object section unchanged except PE's own pattern block

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-editable-shapes` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-editable-shapes/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open). Expected: one rectangle (10,10)-(20,20) mm as an editable shape, not a stitch pattern: selecting it shows the Shapes tab with Sew: line Zigzag Stitch 2.0 mm, density 4.5, under sewing on; region Fill Stitch, density 4.5, direction 0 (OpenStitch's default; PE-DESIGN's tool default is 45), Frequency 30 %; colours region 005 SILVER and line 800 RED. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether the file opens and with what warning, whether the object is editable (handles, Sew type and attributes shown and changeable, Sewing Order lists fill then zigzag), and the status-bar size and stitch count against the file's (12,00 x 12,00 mm, the PEC stitch count). Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11's Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 file signature (tests/fixtures/pe11, every file)
r01-rect.pes: one CEmbLine; the reader parses the whole list (no unparsed class)
internal regression: the PEC section sews the fill in Silver, then the zigzag in Red, as r01's Sewing Order (1 fill silver, 2 zigzag red)
fill in Silver, then the zigzag in Red; PE-DESIGN re-sews the object with the same two blocks
PE-DESIGN re-sews the editable rectangle from the object: the same 12 mm extent (outline plus the 2 mm zigzag)
